authority: User: Let's do that, accepting the proposed grouped common-vs-context-specific predictive comparison; leave the autonomous loop inactive and vault closed.
source: Existing v4.2-C available-only stratum counts. Prior OR/RD results known. Exclude duplicated C6+C7 reference; H/F separate.
question: Does a fixed context-varying log-OR predictor improve held-out conditional log-likelihood over a shared log-OR predictor?
likelihood: Fisher noncentral hypergeometric allocation of qok across sh/ch within each source folio x ending stratum, conditional on ns,nc,total qok k. No held-out intercept fitting. This predicts conditional association, not unconditional qok frequency.

models.varying: beta_shared + delta_context; same Normal(0,2.5^2) shared penalty; independent Normal(0,1^2) context-deviation penalties. Fixed, no tuning. Unseen context has deviation zero and uses its training shared beta.

grouping: Physical numeric folio: recto/verso/all panels together. All f85/f86 source material conservatively one Rosettes foldout group. Same fold map H/F.
folds: 5 folds; sort unique groups by SHA256(seed+":"+group), round-robin assignment. Primary v4.2-C2-primary. Four fixed sensitivities v4.2-C2-partition-1..4; no replacement or selection by scores.
metric: Primary: sum(varying conditional test LL - common conditional test LL) / all eligible origins, in nats/origin. Positive favors varying. Report total nats, informative-origin count and context contributions.
uncertainty: 4999 paired physical-group bootstrap draws of primary saved OOF score differences, seed4263600+H0/F1. Conditional on trained fits and partition; does not propagate training refit uncertainty. No selection p-value or equivalence claim.
controls: Before real CV, qualify conditional PMFs against central hypergeometric and rational odds2 oracles, finite-difference gradients, independent scalar fit, physical grouping and unseen-context fallback. Then exactly20 synthetic datasets per4 scenarios perH/F, same primary folds: commonOR1, commonOR2, modest 1.5 botanical vs2.5 others, strong1 botanical vs4 others. Preserve observed stratum margins ns,nc,k. Record every result; no retuning or trial extension. Controls diagnostic, not nominal model-selection error calibration.
classification: No formal scale-artifact/equivalence classification; fuller v4.2-C section4.3/5 source remains missing. Only report predictive advantage and its limitations.
exclusions: No raw EVT, images, ratings, reserved zodiac, live models, alpha-spending claim, or loop activation.
